acceptance_checks.description: Spark chain artifacts equal every legacy harness case byte-for-byte.
Rerunning a completed root does not change staged, parsed, or report artifacts.
Locking, completion handshake, atomic writes, validation ledger and delivery receipt are exercised.

encoding_policy.byte_transparency: Spark binaryFiles, never UTF-8 text decoding

malformed_record_policy.details: Schema and trailer errors are quarantined and recorded; CUSTBILL_STRICT=1 fails the stage.

empty_input_semantics.details: A header-only CSV and byte-identical XLS are written.

planted_anomalies.description: The finance-compatible XLS remains a byte-identical CSV copy.
